diacritics.description: Replace the combining diaeresis below (U+0324), emitted by some OCR engines, with the standard combining diaeresis (U+0308), which the following Unicode normalization can then compose into precomposed letters such as ä, ö and ü.
Canonical composition, e.g. 'a' + combining diaeresis becomes 'ä'.

old-letters.description: Compatibility composition, which among other things replaces the long s (U+017F) with 's' and the script capital M (U+2133) with 'M'.
Replace the Latin small letter r rotunda (U+A75B) with 'r'.
Replace the double oblique hyphen (U+2E17) with a regular hyphen-minus.
